vm._note: The hypervisor of the virtual machines module. list prints one <name><TAB>running|stopped per machine and fails when the hypervisor does not answer; configure tells it about the <pool>/vm dataset. definition_template, disk_template and nic_template turn the neutral machine record into the backend's definition; firmwares maps the neutral firmware to the backend's word, and a firmware left out is one this edition does not offer.
vm.list: out=$(LC_ALL=C virsh -c qemu:///system list --all) && printf '%s\n' "$out" | awk 'NR>2 && NF {{ print $2 "\t" ($3 == "running" ? "running" : "stopped") }}'
vm.definition_template:
<domain type='kvm'>
  <name>{name}</name>
  <memory unit='MiB'>{memory_mb}</memory>
  <vcpu>{cpus}</vcpu>
  <cpu mode='host-passthrough'/>
  <os{firmware}>
    <type arch='x86_64' machine='q35'>hvm</type>
    <boot dev='hd'/>
    <boot dev='cdrom'/>
  </os>
  <features>
    <acpi/>
    <apic/>
  </features>
  <devices>
{disks}{nics}    <graphics type='vnc' autoport='yes' listen='127.0.0.1'/>
    <video>
      <model type='virtio'/>
    </video>
  </devices>
</domain>
vm.disk_template:
<disk type='block' device='disk'>
      <driver name='qemu' type='raw' cache='none' io='native'/>
      <source dev='/dev/zvol/{zvol}'/>
      <target dev='vd{letter}' bus='virtio'/>
    </disk>
